context_given: 各专业模型需100%通过检查
phrasing_notes: vendor-style tutorial wording, 报批报建 officialese
answer_summary: A Revit-side self-check tool lets users catch problems before exporting to IFC and running the official SZ-IFC checker.

gloss_en: Models passed with self-check tool 1.1.0 can no longer be uploaded to the Shenzhen filing system from 2024-01-01; update to 1.3.0.
title_original: 极智BIM报建交付软件V5.5版本完美适配SZ-IFC自检工具1.3.0版本
question_paraphrase: 1.1.0版本自检通过的模型2024年起传不上去政府报建系统，要更新到1.3.0吗
phrasing_notes: notice-like, version numbers, 小伙伴 casual address
answer_summary: Old checker versions are invalidated; use latest SZ-IFC toolchain (checker and converter plugin).

gloss_en: Some review node values are empty in the self-check tool, meaning fields were lost during IFC export.
title_original: 深圳BIM报建常见问题解析
question_paraphrase: 自检工具里审查节点有些值是空的，导出IFC丢字段了怎么办
phrasing_notes: colloquial fix advice: reinstall or switch computer
answer_summary: User tip: reinstall software or export on another machine; project base point must satisfy CGCS2000; component base coords are auto-extracted.

gloss_en: Notes from a product manager on SZ-IFC: offsets, missing info, big files, viewer differences, slow conversion, coordinate rules.
title_original: BIM 报建工具与 IFC 标准研究
question_paraphrase: SZ-IFC转换和自检遇到构件偏移、信息缺失、文件大、各软件读取不一致、转换慢
answer_summary: Coordinate values need clear rules: invalid blocked, outside Shenzhen range flagged for review; Revit pre-check added using component IDs.

gloss_en: What information is lost when exporting Revit to IFC (class mapping, predefined type, no IfcMapConversion, proxy fallback).
title_original: Revit模型导出时，那些会被弄丢的信息
question_paraphrase: Revit导IFC哪些信息会丢，类别对不上IFC类、坐标转换没了
phrasing_notes: technical, uses IfcExportAs, IfcBuildingElementProxy in English
answer_summary: Mechanical equipment maps to many IFC classes; IfcExportAs helps but not for system families; many proxies mean poor export; coordinates lack Helmert transform; huge base-point coords can break reopening.

gloss_en: IFC exported from Revit is missing elements or steel connections.
title_original: 从 Revit 导出的 IFC 文件中缺少图元或钢结构连接
question_paraphrase: Revit导出IFC后缺图元和钢结构连接
answer_summary: Page body not informative; typical causes: export setup, hidden or unloaded links, connection support.

gloss_en: Materials are not exported to IFC through custom property sets from Revit.
title_original: 材质不会通过 Revit 中的自定义属性集导出为 IFC
question_paraphrase: 自定义属性集里的材质导不进IFC
answer_summary: Known limitation; mapped parameters must have values on the element to export.

gloss_en: BIM lightweighting and web display overview: how to get BIM models into the browser.
title_original: BIM轻量化和Web的应用
question_paraphrase: BIM模型怎么轻量化放到网页上看
answer_summary: Common route: export geometry and properties from the authoring tool and render in WebGL; IFC direct is heavy.

gloss_en: BIM lightweighting path (1): showing Revit models in Unity, with exporting FBX; 100MB model becomes 1GB IFC then 3GB OBJ.
title_original: BIM轻量化之路（一）-unity展示
question_paraphrase: 100M的模型导出IFC有1GB，转OBJ变3GB，机器卡死
phrasing_notes: numeric size complaints, diary-style series title
answer_summary: Avoid IFC-to-OBJ chain; export lighter formats, watch lost materials/properties in FBX; Unity import turned materials gray-white.

gloss_en: Lightweight browser viewer for Revit BIM models based on ThreeJs, step 7 about IFC.
title_original: 基于ThreeJs的Revit-BIM模型轻量化浏览器 step7 IFC

answer_summary: IfcOpenShell lacks a direct glTF path; common route IfcConvert to OBJ/DAE then glTF.

answer_summary: Browser viewer parsing IFC natively, filter by attributes, restructured tree, bill of materials; claims 10x faster (self-reported).

answer_summary: Typical causes: view/phase filters, unloaded links, low detail level; content not read (521).

gloss_en: Guangzhou trial of BIM electronic planning approval: submit BIM model with planning technical review for gov projects over 20,000 m2, prefab, key zones, from 2020-10-01.

question_paraphrase: 哪些项目要同步提交BIM模型做规划报批
answer_summary: Scope: gov-invested single building over 20,000 m2, prefab, key development zones; BIM and 2D must match; during trial BIM result advisory only.

gloss_en: Guangzhou trial of BIM-assisted construction drawing review: upload 2D drawings and BIM model together; owner confirms consistency.
title_original: 广州市住房和城乡建设局关于试行开展房屋建筑工程施工图三维（BIM）电子辅助审查工作的通知

answer_summary: Designers build per city delivery and data standards, upload both, revise both after comments; review advisory in trial.

title_original: 技术｜干货满满，设计师聊广州市BIM审查

answer_summary: Summary of the 2020 trial notice.

gloss_en: Guangzhou 2025 white paper on autonomous and controllable BIM: models flow into the CIM platform after review; drawing-model alignment check since 2023.
title_original: 2025 广州市自主可控BIM应用与发展白皮书
question_paraphrase: 自主可控BIM，审图后模型汇入CIM平台，图模对位不合格传不上去
answer_summary: Models auto-aggregated to CIM; drawing-model alignment check blocks noncompliant uploads (via search summary).

gloss_en: Nanjing BIM planning submission: from 2021-03-01 in pilot zones, projects submit native BIM plus lightweight 宁建模 file after QC; free aided-design software.
title_original: 《关于加快推进我市建筑信息模型（BIM）技术应用的通知》解读

answer_summary: Public buildings over 20,000 m2 and housing over 100,000 m2 in pilot zones must use the system; no change to approval flow.

gloss_en: Nanjing local standard for as-built (completion) BIM delivery; format preferably 宁建模.
title_original: 建筑工程竣工信息模型交付规范 DB 3201/T 1145—2023
question_paraphrase: 竣工模型交付用什么格式，要在施工图模型基础上加变更信息吗
answer_summary: Completion model builds on drawing-review model plus changes; delivered after BIM review and completion filing.

gloss_en: Shanghai BIM smart-review modeling manual: EDM data file for architecture/MEP review, IFC for structural load review.
title_original: 上海市工程建设项目BIM智能辅助审查建模手册 V1.0
question_paraphrase: 上海审查用EDM还是IFC
answer_summary: EDM for discipline review, IFC for structural loads.

question_paraphrase: 深圳哪些项目要用SZ-IFC报建，几个阶段提交
answer_summary: Per search summary of a third-party PDF; verify against original standard.

gloss_en: 2024 paper on automated quality checking of SZ-IFC models for municipal works.
title_original: 基于深圳BIM存储标准的SZ-IFC模型质量自动检查
question_paraphrase: 市政SZ-IFC模型导出与质检工具
answer_summary: Self-check tooling is a practical need before submission.

gloss_en: Paper comparing IFC, STEP, OBJ and BIMBase's PModel exchange format for power-industry BIM software.
title_original: 发电行业BIM软件数据交互（PModel 对比IFC）
question_paraphrase: BIMBase的PModel和IFC怎么互通
answer_summary: Study of parsing, reading and importing PModel and delivery optimisation.

gloss_en: Hubei province BIM cloud platform (June 2026) with H-IFC localized data specification across planning to archiving.
title_original: 湖北省工程建设BIM云平台 H-IFC
question_paraphrase: 湖北H-IFC数据规范是什么
answer_summary: Localised IFC-based specification used full lifecycle.

gloss_en: Marketing article on BIM HVAC design and review in Xiangtan, Hunan; little local specifics.
title_original: 湘潭BIM暖通设计报审流程
question_paraphrase: 湘潭BIM暖通报审流程
answer_summary: Four stages; light on local rules.

gloss_en: Check whether this IFC will pass the Shenzhen self-check: coordinates, empty fields.
prompt: 这个ifc报建自检能过吗？先看下项目基点坐标是不是2000的，还有哪些构件属性是空的
expected_behavior: Read IfcSite/map conversion and placement, check coordinate range and CRS, list elements with empty required properties; state limits since the official checker cannot be run.

gloss_en: Count proxies and group by source category.
prompt: 模型里proxy有多少，都是哪些revit类别来的，导出映射是不是没配好
expected_behavior: Count IfcBuildingElementProxy, group by category/ObjectType, suggest IfcExportAs or mapping changes.

gloss_en: The IFC is 1.2GB and the web viewer hangs; find what bloats it.
prompt: 这个ifc 1.2G，网页端轻量化加载直接卡死，看看是啥撑大的，有没有重复几何
expected_behavior: Report entity counts by class, repeated geometry vs mapped items, large tessellated bodies; suggest splitting by storey and instancing.

gloss_en: List elements whose Pset values are empty.
prompt: 帮我把属性集里值为空的构件拉个清单，按楼层分
expected_behavior: List elements with empty/missing property values by storey with GlobalId and name.

gloss_en: Check the storey hierarchy for reporting.
prompt: 楼层结构对不对？每个构件都挂在IfcBuildingStorey下了吗，没挂的列出来
expected_behavior: Find elements not contained in any IfcBuildingStorey, list them, report storey names and elevations.

gloss_en: Compare v1 and v2 for the second review round.
prompt: 两版模型对比下，审查意见改完后到底动了哪些构件，guid变没变
expected_behavior: Match by GlobalId, report added/deleted/modified elements and property changes; flag GUID regenerations.

gloss_en: Check building area and floor height against drawing figures.
prompt: 核一下建筑面积和层高跟图纸报的数对不对，差多少
expected_behavior: Compute slab/space areas and storey heights from the model, compare to given values, report deviations and uncertainties.

gloss_en: Export a lightweight glTF with properties retained.
prompt: 把结构专业导成glTF，属性别丢，构件id要能对回ifc
expected_behavior: Convert/export structure discipline, keep GlobalId and key properties as metadata, report size and any loss.

gloss_en: IFC export lost elements from linked models.
prompt: 导出ifc缺东西，链接的结构模型好像没带出来，咋回事
expected_behavior: Explain linked models need to be loaded/exported with link option, hidden by view filters, phases; steps to check.

gloss_en: Concrete volume per storey for cost.
prompt: 每层混凝土方量统计下，梁板柱墙分开列，做造价用
expected_behavior: Aggregate quantity volumes by storey and class for concrete elements; note missing QTO and geometry-derived fallback.

gloss_en: Fill classification codes into elements.
prompt: 给所有墙梁板柱补个构件编码属性，按我给的分类表
expected_behavior: Add classification/property to elements per provided mapping, report unmatched, save a new file.

gloss_en: What coordinate system is the model in?
prompt: 这模型坐标系是啥？有没有大坐标，离原点多远
expected_behavior: Report IfcMapConversion/CRS if any, site placement, bounding box distance from origin, warn about far-from-origin precision.

gloss_en: Which structural members from PKPM disappeared after IFC import.
prompt: PKPM导出的ifc导进revit少了好多梁，对比下原ifc里有多少梁，哪些没进去
expected_behavior: Count IfcBeam in the source, compare with imported list, list missing by level and likely causes.

gloss_en: How to convert IFC to glTF with ifcopenshell and keep properties.
prompt: ifcopenshell怎么转gltf，构件属性能带上吗
expected_behavior: Explain geometry iterator plus glTF writer or IfcConvert to glb, attach properties as extras.

gloss_en: Difference between SZ-IFC, CN-IFC and standard IFC4.
prompt: SZ-IFC跟CN-IFC、普通IFC有啥区别？报建只能用SZ-IFC吗
expected_behavior: Explain local profile vs translated standard vs ISO IFC; Shenzhen requires its conversion plugin and checker; verify with official docs.

gloss_en: Check stair widths and corridor widths against code.
prompt: 楼梯净宽和走道宽度查一下，哪些小于规范要求
expected_behavior: Extract stairs and corridor spaces dimensions, compare to a stated threshold, flag with GlobalId; ask which code clause.

gloss_en: Room list with area and department for handover.
prompt: 出个房间清单，编号、名称、面积，运维交付用
expected_behavior: List IfcSpace with number, name, area per storey as table.

gloss_en: Complaint about converter slowness and repeated review rounds.
prompt: 每次改一点点就得重新导ifc再自检，转换慢得要死，有没有办法只导改动的？
expected_behavior: Explain incremental export is not generally supported; suggest worksets/scope export and pre-checks.
